title: TCSP3.0: Template-Based Crystal Structure Prediction with Coefficient-Preserving Element Substitution and Structural Diversity
abstract: arXiv:2610.34029v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Template-based crystal structure prediction (CSP) transfers a known crystal structure to a new composition by element substitution, so its accuracy depends on retrieving suitable templates, mapping elements and ranking the resulting candidates correctly. Auditing the original TCSP2.0 implementation on the T180 benchmark, we found that 469 of its 2,347 selected structures (20%) have the wrong composition, caused by element mappings that ignore stoichiometric coefficients and by sequential text substitution that cascades or corrupts element symbols. We propose TCSP3.0, which enforces coefficient-preserving mappings, substitutes species simultaneously on parsed structures and validates every candidate's composition and cell. It further adds periodic-number retrieval, soft oxidation-state evidence, radius-compatibility scoring, structural deduplication, and ORB-v3 machine-learning-potential relaxation and energy ranking of its candidates,

translated_title: TCSP3.0：具有保系数元素替换与结构多样性的基于模板晶体结构预测方法
translated_abstract: 基于模板的晶体结构预测（CSP）通过元素替换将已知晶体结构转移至新的化学组成，其准确性取决于能否正确检索合适的模板、映射元素以及对生成的候选结构进行排序。在T180基准测试上对原始TCSP2.0实现进行审计时，我们发现其选出的2,347个结构中有469个（20%）化学组成错误，原因是元素映射忽略了化学计量系数，以及顺序文本替换导致元素符号发生级联或损坏。我们提出TCSP3.0，该方法强制执行保系数映射，在解析后的结构上同时替换元素物种，并验证每个候选结构的组成与晶胞。此外，它还引入了按周期数检索、软性氧化态证据、半径兼容性评分、结构去重，以及利用ORB-v3机器学习势对候选结构进行弛豫与能量排序。
tldr: TCSP3.0通过保系数元素替换、解析结构上的同步元素替换以及ORB-v3机器学习势弛豫与能量排序等改进，解决了TCSP2.0中20%候选结构组成错误的问题，显著提升了基于模板的晶体结构预测的准确性。
en_tdlr: TCSP3.0 improves template-based crystal structure prediction by fixing TCSP2.0's 20% wrong-composition error rate through coefficient-preserving element substitution, simultaneous species replacement on parsed structures, and ORB-v3 machine-learning-potential relaxation with energy ranking.
